slots_and_copies.name: slots_2_through_255
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: All 254 remaining 128-byte slots are blank (all-zero body + 0x41 trailer) in this sample; no evidence of use, rotation, or selection.

checksums.name: slot_trailer_byte
checksums.formula_detail: Last byte of every 128-byte slot (offset slot_base+0x7F) differs between blank slots (constant 0x41 across all 254 blank slots) and used slots (0x9E for slot 0, 0xF6 for slot 1). Tested sum8, xor8, 2's-complement-sum, and crc32 (full and truncated to one byte) over multiple candidate byte ranges (slot body excluding trailer, slot body including magic+version string) against both used-slot trailers; none matched. Formula cannot be determined from a single .sav sample.

io_driver_functions.notes: Pure address calculator: (index & 0xFF) * 0x80 + 0x0E000000. Only hardware-save-address reference in the entire 191-function decompilation. No load/store instructions itself. ghidra/callgraph.json lists no callers for this address, which contradicts the explicit call site visible in ghidra/decompiled.c FUN_0806d824; the static C source is treated as ground truth over the callgraph for this edge.

Reads one 3-byte record (u8 flag + u16 LE value) from slot 0 at base+record_index*3+1. Always calls FUN_0806db08(0) -- slot index is always the literal 0. Read-only; never observed writing to the SRAM address.

Comparator/self-test: gates on a device-status byte (*_DAT_0806d75c & 1 == 0), reads a record via FUN_0806d824, and if the record's value field is non-zero, compares the record's flag byte against global RAM reference uRam0806d760 using a branch-free is-nonzero idiom. Returns 1 on mismatch, 0 otherwise.
Calls FUN_0806d71c for record indices 1 and 2, aggregates mismatch results into a 0/1/2 count returned to its two callers.
Unrelated bit-test against a separate global flag (*_DAT_08072b48 & param_1); does not touch the SRAM/slot path. Included because both consumer functions call it alongside the slot-0 self-test.

open_questions: No save WRITE/flush/checksum-computation function exists anywhere in this 191-function trace -- where does it live, and why wasn't it reached by the 2-hop/1-hop seed expansion?
What produces and writes slot 1 (offset 0x0080-0x00FF)? No traced function ever calls FUN_0806db08 with index 1.
What is the slot-trailer-byte algorithm (0x9E / 0xF6 / 0x41)? Unconfirmed with a single sample; needs differential .sav samples with varied slot-0 content.
What does slot-0 offset 0x0000 (0xC0) mean? Never dereferenced by any traced function.
Is the ASCII string 'ver0000006' at offset 0x0075-0x007E genuinely an SDK version tag correlated with the ROM's SRAM_F_V103@14961228 tag, or coincidental? No code reads this span in the capture.
What is the real-world semantic meaning of slot-0 record 0's value field (observed as 6)? Structure is proven; meaning is not.
Does the 256-slot capacity get used beyond slots 0-1 in other save states (e.g., more save files, additional unlocks)? Not observable from this single capture.

Why does ghidra/callgraph.json report zero callers for 0x0806db08 when ghidra/decompiled.c shows an explicit call from FUN_0806d824? The callgraph's edges for this address should not be trusted without cross-checking the static C.
